payloadMux.reason: The widened existing Evolution snapshot is partially written in multiple FSM branches. Quartus implements a wide state/hold/data mux, not just 57 stand-alone FFs. This is payload snapshot muxing; it does not add further serialized or live architectural state.

resourceAnalysis.interpretation: 57 additional bits in each of the existing Evolution snapshot and restore-output banks require 114 logical FFs. Existing live mapper registers are reused. Validation/FSM control can add a few FFs. Fitted register differences additionally include retiming, secondary routing registers and packing throughout unchanged blocks; the entity ledger isolates those effects. No extra RAM or DSP is needed.

registerDenominator: 167640 core ALM register positions = 83820 primary + 83820 secondary. Quartus total fitted registers also includes I/O FFs; dedicated logic/I/O subtotals are listed separately in fit.rpt.
